settings.title: How It All Started
settings.text: Star Sweat began with the belief that humanity deserves more than just hydration — we deserve a cosmic connection. Inspired by the idea that our bodies are made of stardust, we created a way to channel the universe into every sip. Star Sweat is about elevating the human experience through pure, elemental hydration.

settings.title: Why We Do What We Do
settings.text: We want to advance humanity by offering hydration that purifies, aligns, and elevates. Star Sweat is more than water—it’s a cosmic elixir to awaken the spirit and fuel the journey ahead. Every drop is a reminder of our limitless potential.

settings.title: What Makes Us Different
settings.text: Star Sweat is crafted with molecular hydrogen, gold, and platinum to create an experience that’s both transformative and transcendent. Our water detoxifies, aligns, and fuels on a cellular level—moving humanity forward, one hydrated soul at a time.
